title: Delay Risk Review
description: Review of projects with significant observed or predicted schedule delay.

steps.title: Review the schedule position
steps.guidance: Compare planned vs actual start and end dates and the predicted delay from the model. Identify which milestones are behind.

steps.title: Identify the delay cause
steps.guidance: Request the implementing agency's explanation: land/site issues, funds flow, contractor performance, seasonal factors, statutory clearances.

steps.title: Check fund-release timing
steps.guidance: Verify whether instalment releases were timely relative to progress; funding gaps are a common recoverable delay cause.

steps.title: Record a conclusion and follow-up plan
steps.guidance: Record the verified cause, a recovery plan or revised timeline if applicable, and whether escalation is warranted.
